name: sellsword
description: Hire Sellsword for one hard problem and it owns the outcome end to end. Five Opus agents (dispatcher, recon, builder, auditor, fresh-eyes) investigate, plan, execute and verify across code, servers and infrastructure: SSH into systems, change infra, edit code, debug deploys. The builder switches between investigating, planning, executing and verifying. Recon has a bounded budget, a stuck builder retries from three angles with an arbiter, and the auditor and fresh-eyes must each produce an evidence ledger of commands they actually ran. One checkpoint (plan approval) for side-effecting tasks, none for pure investigation. State lives in .sellsword/runs/ for resume. /sellsword:goal runs the builder, auditor and fresh-eyes loop unattended until both verifiers pass, enforced by a Stop hook and bounded by cycle and time caps.
